{{Top|leg}}
'''Credit slips''' were a form of [[Currency/Legends|currency]] used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Con artist/Legends|Con artists]] often carried [[Forger (profession)/Legends|bogus]] credit slips to assist them in their schemes.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
